summary: title: Moonshot AI tags: provider, lab, china, model, reasoning, coding, open-weight, long-context, multimodal, agentic, pricing, api, token-cost, timeline # Moonshot AI ## Overview Moonshot AI (月之暗面) is a Beijing-based AI startup founded in March 2023 by Yang Zhilin and Tsinghua University classmates. The company is a member of China's "Six AI Tigers" and has raised $1B+ total funding from Alibaba, Tencent, Meituan, and HongShan at valuations reaching $3B. Moonshot AI is best known for the Kimi chatbot and the Kimi K2 series — a 1T-parameter MoE model with only 32B active parameters, released under a modified MIT license.
